description: MemoryBackend::get_objects silently truncates results to 500 when ids=None. The return value has no truncation flag; a test with 501 objects calling get_objects(None) will receive 500 results with no error or indication that results were cut. A test author may write a test that inadvertently passes despite incomplete coverage because results are silently missing.
title: MemoryBackend MAX_FETCH_ALL truncates silently with no indication to callers
